CIV.note: The observatory sits under the finance ministry; nothing on the central bank.

facts.fact: The finance ministry's Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers (OQSF-CI) handles complaints about financial services including e-money (mobile money) issuers, through a digital complaints-management application; its executive secretary said it logged 156 complaints in 2024.

systems.system: OQSF-CI (Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers)

CIV.note: The OQSF-CI complaints application is about financial providers, not public services.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Mobile money issuers are named only as OQSF-CI's subjects; no service is described.
